picks.editorial_note: MIT's Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins won the prestigious Pritzker Prize for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, a landmark recognition of AI's role in addressing the global antibiotic resistance crisis.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge team's AI-guided vaccine design technique achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in animal trials, demonstrating AI's potential to dramatically accelerate pandemic-preparedness vaccine development.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska will lead cybersecurity for FabAID, a $24.5 million NSF-funded national infrastructure project for AI-driven science, underscoring growing federal investment in secure AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC's strategic framework agreement to build HSBC's AI & Emerging Technology Institute exemplifies deepening academia-finance collaboration on applied AI innovation.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: A $39.5 million ARPA-H consortium spanning Boston University, Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell is developing AI-enabled robotic catheter technology for remote stroke treatment, a major cross-sector push into AI-driven emergency medicine.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team is using AI with satellite imaging and health data to uncover environmental drivers of Alzheimer's and dementia, a significant application of AI to public health research.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills from purely synthetic self-generated data, a notable scientific finding with implications for reducing AI's dependence on real-world training data.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding to ANU for AI-assisted fusion simulation modernization highlights growing industry investment in AI for clean-energy science.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: ASU's $3.2 million NIH-funded project uses deep learning on retinal imaging and biomarkers to screen for preclinical Alzheimer's disease, a promising early-detection tool with real-world clinical potential.
picks.title: What the eye may reveal about Alzheimer’s

picks.editorial_note: A Georgetown analysis of Anthropic's pledge of up to $100 billion in equity to the public raises major questions about wealth distribution and accountability as AI companies amass unprecedented valuations.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University
